task.title: How to Search Virginia Court for Walnut Hill Evictions

user_message.content:
Go to the Virginia General District Court Online Case Information System at https://eapps.courts.state.va.us/gdcourts/welcomePage.do

Search for all eviction/unlawful detainer civil cases related to the property "Walnut Hill" at 102 Lieutenants Run Drive, Petersburg, VA 23805.

Steps:
1. Navigate to the site
2. Select "Civil" case type
3. Select locality: Petersburg (it's a city, not a county)
4. Search by plaintiff name: try "Walnut Hill", "Granite Walnut Hill", "Granite Property Management", "Granite Associates", or similar variations
5. Also try searching the new Virginia OCIS system at https://eapps.courts.state.va.us/ocis/landing if the old system doesn't work
6. Collect all eviction/unlawful detainer cases found — case numbers, defendant names, filing dates, status, hearing dates
7. Compile everything into a clear list/report

Save the results to /home/ubuntu/walnut_hill_evictions.md
